stations.label: Work order and asset desk
robot_device_boundary: Condition and sample allocation
Qualified station readiness

stations.label: Material and specimen preparation
robot_device_boundary: Robot retrieves, dispenses, assembles and labels
Manufacturing method gates must resolve before fabrication

stations.label: Guarded pattern/flood-exposure station
robot_device_boundary: Robot loads/unloads and starts verified job
Device owns illumination

stations.label: Contained development station
robot_device_boundary: Robot separates sandwich, rinses and recovers
Solvent amounts and cleanup method gated

stations.label: Contained dry-assembly station
robot_device_boundary: Robot weighs/loads/closes/docks/starts/stops/unloads
Device owns roller motion

stations.label: Contained loose-particle removal
robot_device_boundary: Robot positions array and triggers qualified removal
No uncontrolled particle ejection

stations.label: Microscopy and reimaging
robot_device_boundary: Robot transports, docks, aligns, selects acquisition and recovers
Instrument owns exposures

stations.label: Guarded bead-impact station
robot_device_boundary: Robot loads separate target and impactor
Device owns release only when configured; camera owns capture

stations.label: Mechanical test station
robot_device_boundary: Robot mounts film and selects sites
Separate device receipts for indentation and pull-off

stations.label: Photo-DSC station
robot_device_boundary: Robot prepares/loads/retrieves pans
Instrument owns thermal and illumination program

stations.label: Electron microscopy and EDS station
robot_device_boundary: Robot mounts and transfers only after specimen-prep gate
Instrument owns vacuum/acquisition; no automatic specimen return

stations.label: Qualified PDMS processing station
robot_device_boundary: Robot prepares, coats and unloads under supplied recipe
No invented spin/dip/spray method

stations.label: Contained challenge station
robot_device_boundary: Robot configures/loads/starts/recovers selected challenge
No harmful open dust or uncontained fragile-substrate drop

stations.label: Environmental chamber
robot_device_boundary: Robot loads and retrieves identified specimens
Device owns7dayhold and logs excursions

stations.label: Storage, cleanup and waste station
robot_device_boundary: Robot returns safe specimens and reconciles all entities
Broken glass, resin/solvent and bead waste remain segregated

stations.label: Parameterized physical transit between recorded stations
robot_device_boundary: A MOVE occurrence must replace the template endpoints with actual source and destination station IDs. This is not a room or autonomous device.

stations.label: Virtual analysis-service interface
robot_device_boundary: Robot submits records and reviews returned evidence; sample remains at its separately recorded physical location.

mobile_robot: Human-like mobile laboratory robot with qualified manipulation tools. No fixed-arm default, preexisting grasp reach, room dimensions or locomotion success is assumed.
transfer_invariants: Source station and destination station identified for every move
Manipulated sample, tool, support carrier and orientation are observable
Source release and destination support are independently checked
Active array surfaces are not generic grasp targets
Actual robot path and force settings require qualification, not values invented from the paper
